subject: bio.c: Organize all worker data in a struct (#2530)
reason: The change is a mechanical refactor of bio.c that gathers the four parallel per-worker arrays (thread id, mutex, condvar, job list) into one struct array, plus __thread→_Thread_local spelling swaps in io_threads.c, networking.c and vset.c. Every lock/condvar/queue access maps 1:1 to the same worker as before; inBioThread() keeps identical semantics (thread-local index, 0 for worker 0 and the main thread), bioKillThreads' pthread_self comparison becomes the equivalent pthread_equal, and initialization order in bioInit is unchanged. No job routing, locking order, drain condition, reply, or confi
